Chapter 528: Chapter 19: Influencing the Battlefields of Different Races (Please Subscribe)_2

The excitement had already engulfed numerous human evolvers, but now, for the Galaxy Master, killing those of the Eighth Layer was as easy as slaughtering chickens.

No, it was easier than slaughtering chickens, for chickens at least struggle a bit before dying, but those of the Tianyu Clan at the Eighth Layer couldn’t even struggle before they perished.

The human Evolvers had contemplated winning the war against the Tianyu Clan under the leadership of the Galaxy Master, but that would inevitably require a hard-fought battle, and even result in the deaths of a few human Eighth Layer Evolvers.

And now?

Had the Galaxy Master solved everything?

From beginning to end, apart from the Baiyun Lord who had taken action, these Eighth Layer Evolvers were just like ornaments, merely watching from behind.

...

“Galaxy Master!”

“The invincible Galaxy Master!”

All the Eighth Layer beings had become utterly fanatical—they had never seen an Eighth Layer being so powerful that they could battle those of the Ninth Rank, a rarity for human civilization’s Evolvers.

Human civilization had a vast population with individuals, on average, at the bottom in terms of talent among the Peak Clans, although prodigies occasionally emerged.

However, members of other powerful Peak Clans could also produce prodigious talents.

Throughout the two million years of the Starry Sea Era, the greatest prodigies born of human civilization, compared to the strongest prodigies of the same rank from other Peak Clans, always had minor differences, with only a few achieving parity.

But now,

the Galaxy Master, although at the Eighth Layer, had left other Eighth Layer beings from the Peak Clans far behind.

…

Deep within the layers of space,

a Ninth Rank member of the Tianyu Clan glared at Lin Yuan, the murderous intent in his eyes nearly spilling out.

At this moment, the strength displayed by the Galaxy Master was so terrifying that even he felt a tingling scalp. Such a peerless genius living another day would mean colossal future losses for the Tianyu Clan.

“Ancestor…”

The Ninth Rank Tianyu being immediately began contacting their clan’s ancestor.

The Tianyu Clan, along with human civilization and the Insect Race, belonged to the Peak Clans that stood at the pinnacle of the universe, overseeing the Myriad Clans.

The Tianyu Clan had seven ancestors, each a Supreme Being, who mostly stayed out of affairs.

However, at this moment, the Ninth Rank Tianyu being deemed it necessary to inform the ancestor about the Galaxy Master.

Before long,

the ancestor’s response reached his mind.

“There are Supreme Beings from human civilization looking this way…”

The Ninth Rank Tianyu being was slightly stunned, realizing he couldn’t do anything to the Galaxy Master.

Even if the ancestors intervened, the human side’s Supreme Beings would also act, and instead of eliminating the Galaxy Master, it would only escalate the intensity of the war.

…

Elsewhere, in the depths of the heavy spatial layers,

the human Ninth Rank Evolver, Xilan, looked anxious, having also contacted a Supreme Being in advance.

After Lin Yuan had killed dozens of Tianyu Clan Eighth Layer beings in a few breaths, he realized the seriousness of the situation.

The talent of the Galaxy Master far exceeded expectations.

Relying solely on a single Ninth Rank would hardly curb the murderous intent of the Tianyu Clan, so he had directly contacted a Supreme Being.

The response from the Supreme Being was…

They had been watching all along and advised him not to panic.

“It seems that the terrifying talent of the Galaxy Master had already caught the attention of a few Supreme Beings from our human civilization…” Xilan thought to himself.

Under normal circumstances, even if a Supreme Being took note of this ancient exotic battlefield, they would only divert an insignificant part of their consciousness.

But just now, the tone of the Supreme Being’s response seemed as if they were also watching the battle?

…

Whoosh.

Lin Yuan’s figure disappeared again.

He appeared next to the human Eighth Layer beings.

“We’ll leave the cleanup to you guys,” Lin Yuan said, looking at the Baiyun Lord, “I’ll be taking my leave.”

“Thank you, Galaxy Master,” Baiyun Lord and the other Eighth Layer beings said excitedly and spiritedly, the youngest of them nearly a hundred thousand years old, yet they all looked up to Lin Yuan, even feeling a sense of pride.

“Galaxy Master, surely your strength has already surpassed many of the Ninth Rank, hasn’t it?” Baiyun Lord couldn’t help but exclaim.

“Surpassed the Ninth Rank?”

Lin Yuan smiled faintly.

The power of the Taiji Primordial Spirit indeed surpassed that of ordinary Ninth Ranks, but Lin Yuan’s strongest combat power still lay in his True Body.

An Inner World spanning over a hundred million miles in radius, the enhancement of power was entirely transformative.

“Everyone, wrap things up,”

Lin Yuan said casually.

Having lost dozens of Eighth Layer Titans, it was absolutely impossible for the Tianyu Clan to continue sending reinforcements to this battlefield.

Continue sending reinforcements?

Just so Lin Yuan could keep killing them?

The Tianyu Clan had robust resources. Losing dozens of Eighth Layer Titans didn’t have a significant impact, but that didn’t mean they were fools.

The combat power Lin Yuan had displayed now was completely exceptional. Even if more Eighth Layer Titans came, they were destined to die.

With this in mind, it was better to give up on Battlefield B0001 and minimize the losses.

“Whoosh!”

Lin Yuan stayed put, quickly taking control of the situation as the human Evolvers took over, confirming that the Tianyu Clan had lost any interest in this battlefield before he disappeared soundlessly.

…

Lin Yuan wreaked havoc in the B0001 Exotic Battlefield, killing dozens of Eighth Layer Titans, including six of the strongest Eighth Layer beings of the Tianyu Clan.

This news spread like a hurricane to other battlefields.

The Different Species residing in numerous medium-sized battlefields grew fearful, knowing that Lin Yuan, having appeared in Battlefield B0001, could also descend upon their own battlefields.

With the Galaxy Master’s ability to annihilate dozens of Eighth Layer Titans, wouldn’t his arrival on other exotic battlefields be completely overwhelming?

Who could withstand the Galaxy Master?

Suddenly, great pressure mounted on the major clans. Under pressing circumstances, the Different Species’ strategies on the battlefields began to shrink. Unless absolutely necessary, they wouldn’t lightly leave their “strongholds.”

The human civilization Evolvers on all battlefields immediately felt their pressure decrease dramatically, turning the tide of the battle.

Even several peak clans secretly bestowed Tenth Rank Secret Treasures, all to prevent the arrival of the Galaxy Master.

Since human civilization began its expansion, no Eighth Layer being had ever managed, with their own power, to influence all medium-sized and small-sized exotic battlefields, causing the many Different Species to tremble and preemptively change their strategies.

This was something only a Supreme Being could accomplish.

…

After making his move, Lin Yuan returned to that 30,000-meter-long Permanent Spatial Rift to continue accumulating World-Breaking Origin Force.

“It’s a pity, this kind of sweeping through a battlefield can only be done once, the second time the risk will increase dramatically,”

Lin Yuan sighed.

This time, he had successfully breached the B0001 Exotic Battlefield, catching the Tianyu Clan completely off guard.

The Tianyu Clan had never anticipated that Lin Yuan’s power was so fearsome, that he could kill Eighth Layer Titans with ease.

But after this experience, the Different Species on other battlefields became cautious, surely setting traps in anticipation of Lin Yuan.

Perhaps Tenth Rank Secret Treasures?

Or other one-time treasures capable of unleashing terrifying potential?

Tenth Rank Secret Treasures, even in the hands of an Eighth Layer Titan, couldn’t unleash one percent of their potential.

But they could still pose a threat to Lin Yuan, those were killing weapons of Tenth Rank powers.

“This should be enough.”

“With precautions against my arrival, the Different Species on those battlefields will have to be cautious for the time being, which will also alleviate some of the pressure on human Evolvers,”

Lin Yuan thought secretly.

His influence on other battlefields was entirely a trick, exploiting the rule that medium-sized exotic battlefields only allowed Eighth Layer beings to act.

To truly influence the situation, to affect the other peak clans,

One had to become a Supreme Being to achieve that.

…

Milky Way Main Star.

Lin Yuan’s Taiyin Primordial Spirit rushed over, bringing all the spoils from Battlefield B0001.

The Taiyang Divine Spirit stayed by that 30,000-meter-long Permanent Spatial Rift to maintain an accumulation “efficiency” of World-Breaking Origin Force for one hundred fifty days.

As for the Taiyin Primordial Spirit, it was free to deliver spoils to Lin Yuan.

“Big win,”

A smile appeared on Lin Yuan’s face, only he knew how great his gains were.

“Hmm? The Goddess of Freedom has already settled ten percent of the total merit? The Merit Points are already in my account?”

Before Lin Yuan even tallied the spoils in his possession, he received another piece of good news.

“I wonder how many Merit Points it is…” Lin Yuan, with an expectant look, immediately checked.
